name: v0.4.19
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(web-studio): share user skills and switch users by @yufeng201 in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4706
* Revert "feat(web-studio): share user skills and switch users" by @yufeng201 in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4771
* feat(web-studio): add Agent Experience module by @yufeng201 in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4716
* fix(memory-plugins): report client-side MCP proxy timeouts as -32004 instead of unreachable by @now-ing in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4741
* fix(plugins): treat camelCase isError as an error tool result by @feel-think in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4724
* feat(bot): remove obsolete code and align provider status by @yeshion23333 in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4769
* fix(localfs): 修正文件目录扫描的错误类型 by @qin-ctx in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4772
* fix(session): batch Phase 2 extraction by auto-commit policy by @heaoxiang-ai in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4644
* fix(storage): 统一 cp/mv 向量路径查询，避免后端算子不兼容 by @KCHENPENGFEI in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4774
* session: add restricted Python DSL extraction protocol and make it the default by @chenjw in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4581
* ci(openclaw): run the plugin Vitest suite when the plugin or the lane changes by @now-ing in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4753
* refactor(openclaw-plugin): remove stale client-facade seam leftovers by @ralf003 in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4720
* refactor(openclaw-plugin): route setup CLI network probes through the probe service by @now-ing in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4731
* refactor(openclaw-plugin): remove dead recall-trace compat exports by @now-ing in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4732
* fix(queuefs): give SemanticMsg a per-instance creation timestamp by @now-ing in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4757
* test(codex-plugin): remove startup race in auto-recall compressor test by @now-ing in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4750
* feat(compile): 由 OV 托管外部任务生命周期 by @qin-ctx in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4436
* docs: refresh agent access guide cards by @ManAsWind in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4804
* fix(watches): scope non-ROOT watch access to the owning user by @fengluodb in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4802
* fix(codex): reuse shared recall compressor by @fancyboi999 in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4445
* feat(feishu): add recursive wiki materialization by @sponge225 in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4763
* feat(acl): add restricted inheritance mode by @qin-ctx in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4695
* docs: avoid extra API key blocks in agent guides by @ManAsWind in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4811
* fix(embedding): cache query embeddings per request to stop the context face re-embedding the same text by @feel-think in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4794
* test(fs): align cp overwrite integration expectation by @sponge225 in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4809
* fix(vectordb): 降低本地 schema 自动升级的内存占用 by @qin-ctx in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4819
* feat(feishu): unify folder and file imports with Understanding by @ShaoZegangByte in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4806

## New Contributors
* @feel-think made their first contribution in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4724
* @ralf003 made their first contribution in https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/4720

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/compare/v0.4.18...v0.4.19
